summary: Journey page redesign testing complete. All 14 requested features verified working correctly on both Florida State University (prog_f867cdaa6073 with timeline data) and Baylor University (prog_5bbaf2623d6f with empty timeline).
passed_tests: Journey page loads correctly with Next Step Hero card at top
Next Step Hero shows contextual action based on follow-up dates (103 days overdue -> 'Send Follow-up Now')
Next Step Hero 'Send Follow-up Now' button opens email composer
Next Step Hero 'Snooze 3 days' button works and updates follow-up date (Nov 3 -> Nov 6)
Timeline section shows events with icons (Camp Meeting, Phone Call, Email, Other)
Timeline header has 'Log Interaction' button that opens log form
Timeline header has 'Send Email' button that opens email composer
AI Insights sidebar card renders first with Generate button and feature tags (Relationship Summary, Draft Email, Tips)
AI Insights Generate button triggers AI summary generation (shows 'Analyzing your journey...')
Coaches panel shows with add (+) button
Add coach form opens with name/role/email/phone fields and Save/Cancel buttons
Interest Level meters are interactive - clicking bar updates value (verified 8/10 -> 5/10 with toast)
Key Dates panel shows follow-up due dates
Schedule Follow-up section works with date picker and action input
Set Reminder button saves follow-up and shows success toast
Status badges (Status/Reply/Priority) are clickable and show dropdown options
Back button navigates to /pipeline
Empty timeline state shows 'No interactions yet' message (verified on Baylor)
Next Step Hero dynamically changes: overdue follow-up, no reply, in conversation states
Sidebar layout order verified: AI Insights -> Coaches -> Interest Level -> Key Dates -> Schedule Follow-up
critical_code_review_comments: Journey page redesign well-implemented with all required features
Next Step Hero card provides excellent contextual guidance based on program state
All data-testid attributes properly set for testing
Dynamic state handling works correctly (follow-up dates, status, reply)
seed_data_creation: Used existing programs: prog_f867cdaa6073 (Florida State University) with timeline data, prog_5bbaf2623d6f (Baylor University) with empty timeline
